fields.subject: QueryStatement
fields.condition: the Lazy<QueryStatement> was produced by the Create(name) or Create(name, parameterNames) overload, neither of which is given an explicit folder or extension
fields.trigger: a caller evaluates Value on that Lazy<QueryStatement> for the first time
fields.response: resolve the statement file using whatever values QueryStatement.Folder and QueryStatement.Extension hold at the moment Value is evaluated, not whatever they held when Create was called
fields.postcondition: reassigning QueryStatement.Folder or QueryStatement.Extension after Create returns but before Value is first read changes which file that Lazy<QueryStatement> loads
